document_title: S.L.458.39 Delegation to Medicines Authority Order
finding: Licensing Authority delegates article3(2)(m),(n),(o) functions to Medicines Authority. Clause(j) is not enumerated.
limitation: Whole one-page original inspected; published scope now verified. Whether broad clause(m) covers ordinary marketing grants despite distinct clause(j), current amendment/commencement chain and decision signatory require legal review.

limitation: Retrieved consolidation header does not prove exhaustive current amendment/effectiveness history. Statutory office, separate corporate Medicines Authority and ministry must not be equated.
